newsitem.title: USA: Q-Zar Inc buys shareholder block.
newsitem.headline: Q-Zar Inc buys shareholder block.

text.p: The management of Q-Zar, a leisure and entertainment company, said Friday that it bought 7.3 million shares of Q-Zar stock from McCarthy Corp, a venture capital firm.

Q-Zar told Reuters the purchase was made on the open market totaling C$45 million or $32 million. In a statement, the company said the McCarthy stake represented the largest single shareholding block in Q-Zar.

Michael Boyle, the chief financial officer of Q-Zar said, "they (McCarthy) were one of the founders of the company, putting up seed money, but as we went public, their stake was diluted and they wanted to move on. That's how venture capitalists usually work."
The payment will be made over three years, and the management shares will not be put back into the company treasury, Boyle said.
